The case was jointly investigated by the Penghu District Public Prosecutor's Office Zhongshu Lin Jiyin, who commanded the Penghu Detection and Defense Branch of the Coast Guard Branch and the Seventh Shore Patrol of the Golden Horse Pen Branch. After several months of investigation, it was determined that the captain of the "Hong" ship purchased a total of 62 fishery power oil discounts from CNPC Penghu Ma Gong Fishing Boat Filling Station from October 10, 112 to February 1, 115 with false operating hours.
